title: opensquilla/opensquilla
claim: OpenSquilla — an open-source microkernel AI agent (CLI, web UI, chat channels) built around token efficiency: same budget, more useful work per token.
why_good: Token spend is the real bill for agent users, and almost every framework competes on features instead. This one is actually maintained — 34 contributors, 412 commits in 30 days — with efficiency as a measurable, benchmarkable claim.
value: Hosted/managed version plus enterprise support: 'cut your agent inference bill' is a budget line buyers already understand, and efficiency benchmarks make the pitch provable.
risk: Falling model prices steadily erode the efficiency angle, and first-party agent runtimes from the model labs could leave an indie agent kernel as a hobbyist tool. Repo topics suggest OpenClaw lineage — differentiation has to be proven, not claimed.

zh.claim: OpenSquilla —— 围绕 token 效率打造的开源微内核 AI agent(CLI、网页、聊天渠道):同样预算,每个 token 干更多有用的活。
zh.why_good: token 花费才是 agent 用户真正的账单,而几乎所有框架都在拼功能而非省钱;这个还真有人维护——34 位贡献者。
zh.value: 托管版 + 企业支持:「砍掉你的 agent 推理账单」是买家早就懂的预算项,效率本身就是卖点。
zh.risk: 模型价格持续下降会不断削弱"省钱"这个卖点,而模型厂商的一方 agent 运行时可能把独立玩家挤掉。
zh.hook: 盯着 token 账单的 agent 重度用户——包括用不了 opus 的中国用户——每天在 issue 区把它往主力工具改。
zh.does: 开源微内核 AI agent（CLI、Web UI、聊天通道），核心卖点是 token 效率：同样预算干更多活。亮点：34 位贡献者、月 400+ 提交，企业微信/Telegram 通道由社区自发接入。
zh.gap: 只有极客用得了——token 效率这个能力只有 CLI 和自部署，外面没有产品；tracker 里可见的中国用户需求（国产模型 fallback、IM 通道）还不是任何人的产品。
zh.counter: 仓库标签显示 OpenClaw 血统——差异化要证明而不是宣称；模型降价持续侵蚀效率卖点；在别人快速演进的内核上盖房子是永久的 rebase 跑步机。
zh.differentiator: 不跟内核竞争——做包装：面向用不了 opus 的中国用户（#245 就是需求本身）的国产模型优先、开箱即用助手。
zh.consumer_angle: 给用国产模型的中国用户一个『心疼你 token 预算』的成品 agent——tracker 里他们已经在排队撞墙了。

hook: Agent power users watching their token bill — including Chinese users locked out of frontier models — file issues daily to make this framework their daily driver.
pick_reason: The project addresses a clear market need for token efficiency in AI agents, backed by strong community engagement and active development.

does: Open-source microkernel AI agent (CLI, web UI, chat channels) built around token efficiency: same budget, more useful work per token. Standout: 34 contributors, 400+ commits/month, WeCom/Telegram channel integrations landing from the community.
gap: Only geeks can use it — the token-efficiency capability ships as CLI + self-hosting with no product around it, and the Chinese-user demand visible in the tracker (domestic-model fallback, IM channels) is nobody's product.
counter: Repo topics suggest OpenClaw lineage — differentiation has to be proven, not claimed; falling model prices erode the whole efficiency pitch; building on someone else's fast-moving kernel is a permanent rebase treadmill.
differentiator: Don't compete with the kernel — package it: a domestic-model-first, install-and-go assistant for Chinese users who literally cannot run opus (issue #245 is the demand).
consumer_angle: A packaged 'agent that respects your token budget' for Chinese users on domestic models — the tracker already shows them arriving and hitting walls.
